thread:
maya: Hey team — new user hit the quickstart and their first call failed with a 402. Can someone check billing gating for a fresh workspace?

devon: Bummer. Do you have the exact error payload? 402 usually means payment_required or trial limit hit.

maya: Pasted the logs from their browser console and our server proxy: 
```json
{
  \"status\":402,
  \"error\":\"Payment required - workspace pending billing\",
  \"request_id\":\"req_8a7b9\"
}
```

samir: @maya can you repro locally with the sample app? Might be the quickstart picks up org_id from env and that workspace is set to "billing_pending" state.

maya: Tried locally using `NEXT_PUBLIC_REDWOOD_KEY` set to their key — same 402 from the hosted endpoint. The SDK retries once then gives up. No helpful error message in client.

devon: That retry behaviour is supposed to surface a clear onboarding hint. Looks like the JS SDK interprets 402 as transient and does one retry. We should show a clearer UX and include the workspace billing URL.

ella: @devon where's the mapping that turns HTTP 402 -> SDK error message? I think it's in `packages/js-client/src/errors.ts`. Could add a special case to include a link: `https://app.redwood.ai/orgs/{org}/billing`

samir: Another edge: the sample Next.js app's serverless proxy swallows the `x-workspace-id` header if you run `vercel dev`. Might explain why it hits a different workspace. The repro steps: run `yarn dev` with `REDWOOD_KEY` and call `/api/firstcall`.

maya: Repro steps I used: fresh Chrome incognito, cloned `redwood-starter`, `yarn`, set env, `yarn dev`. First call stack: 
```
client.js:45 Uncaught (in promise) Error: Request failed with status code 402
    at createError (axios.js:??)
    at settle (axios.js:??)
    at XMLHttpRequest.handleLoad (axios.js:??)
```

devon: OK. Action items: (1) devex team to update quickstart README with explicit billing gating note and link + how to check workspace state in console; (2) SDK: map 402 to a friendlier error with direct billing link and no retry; (3) sample app: add warning when `x-workspace-id` header is missing and detect common dev proxies (Vercel, Netlify).

ella: I can take the README patch. I'll add a short snippet: 
```md
If you see a 402/Payment required on first call, visit https://app.redwood.ai/orgs/<org>/billing and complete billing setup or attach a payment method. For local dev, ensure your env var REDWOOD_KEY corresponds to the intended workspace and your proxy preserves headers.
```

samir: I'll open a PR in the JS SDK to treat 402 as NonRetryableOnboardError with `help_url` in the error object. Will include the sample log text so Sentry groups these separately.

maya: Thanks all. One more: can we have onboard-bot send an automated DM to users who hit 402 with a link to docs? Low priority but could reduce support tickets.

onboard-bot: Automated suggestion: "It looks like your workspace hasn't completed billing setup. See https://docs.redwood.ai/onboarding/billing for next steps." :wave:

devon: Nice. Let's track the SDK PR and README change. Assigning 1d for documentation, 2d for SDK change.

maya: Filing a support ticket and attaching this thread. I'll follow up if user still blocks. :thumbsup:
